description: Header file defining the class hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security, which provides APIs for managing WiFi endpoint security parameters such as security mode, WEP key, PSK, and passphrase, including methods for retrieving security configurations and managing instances.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security
classes.description: Class providing access to WiFi endpoint security parameters and instance management.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security_ModeEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves the security mode enabled for the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security_WEPKey
methods.description: Retrieves the WEP key as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security_PreSharedKey
methods.description: Retrieves the PreSharedKey (PSK) as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_Profile_Security_KeyPassphrase
methods.description: Retrieves the passphrase used to generate the PreSharedKey.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the class for a given device ID.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all existing instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and deletes a specific instance.
